_readme: Per-app JS budgets, gzip KB (TASK-031; every dimension blocking since TASK-022). `initialKb` counts SvelteKit entry+chunks; for the SPAs it is the Vite manifest entry's static import closure (what the script + modulepreload chain loads at boot) — measured 74.6 KB for admin and 40.9 KB for platform-admin in rc.3, budgeted with headroom inside the architecture's admin ≤ 250 target. The per-route `routeKb` and the SPA per-chunk `chunkKb` cap every other chunk. `fonts` budgets the Japanese preloaded subsets raw (woff2 is already compressed) as their own line — a single global font number would hide the one hard locale. TASK-032 had lowered storefront initial to 88 and marketing to 50 after sharding the i18n catalogs.
